title: The Book of Revelation Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Revelation — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
verses.decoded: This is the revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what will soon happen. He sent his angel to give this message to his servant John.

verses.kjv: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
verses.decoded: John tells what he heard from God’s word, the message from Jesus Christ, and everything he saw.

verses.kjv: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
verses.decoded: Happy is the one who reads this prophecy aloud, and those who hear it and obey what is written, because the time is near.

verses.kjv: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
verses.decoded: John writes to the seven churches in Asia: May you have grace and peace from the one who is, who was, and who is coming, and from the seven Spirits before his throne.

verses.kjv: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
verses.decoded: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the first to rise from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. He loves us and washed our sins away with his own blood.

verses.kjv: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: He made us kings and priests to serve God his Father. Glory and power belong to him forever. Amen.

verses.kjv: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
verses.decoded: Look, he is coming with the clouds, and everyone will see him, even those who pierced him. All the nations of the earth will mourn because of him. Yes, Amen.

verses.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
verses.decoded: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end, says the Lord, the one who is, who was, and who is coming, the Almighty.

verses.kjv: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: I, John, your brother and partner in suffering, in the kingdom, and in patient endurance in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of God’s word and the testimony about Jesus.

verses.kjv: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
verses.decoded: On the Lord’s day, I was filled with the Spirit and heard a loud voice behind me like a trumpet.

verses.kjv: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
verses.decoded: It said, 'I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last. Write down what you see and send it to the seven churches in Asia: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamos, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.'

verses.kjv: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
verses.decoded: I turned to see the voice speaking to me. When I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands.

verses.kjv: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
verses.decoded: In the middle of the lampstands was someone like a Son of Man, dressed in a long robe with a gold belt around his chest.

verses.kjv: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verses.decoded: His head and hair were white like wool, as white as snow, and his eyes were like flames of fire.

verses.kjv: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
verses.decoded: His feet looked like polished bronze glowing in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of rushing waters.

verses.kjv: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
verses.decoded: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp twoedged sword came from his mouth. His face shone like the sun at full strength.

verses.kjv: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
verses.decoded: When I saw him, I fell down at his feet as if dead. But he placed his right hand on me and said, 'Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last.'

verses.kjv: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
verses.decoded: I am the one who lives. I was dead, but now I am alive forever. I hold the keys of death and the grave.

verses.kjv: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
verses.decoded: Write down what you have seen, what is now, and what will happen later.

verses.kjv: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
verses.decoded: The mystery of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and the seven golden lampstands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

verses.kjv: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
verses.decoded: Write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: This is the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands saying,

verses.kjv: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:
verses.decoded: I know your actions, your hard work, your patience, and that you cannot tolerate evil people. You have tested those who claim to be apostles but are not, and you found them to be liars.

verses.kjv: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
verses.decoded: You have endured and been patient, and you have worked hard for my name’s sake without giving up.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
verses.decoded: But I have something against you because you have abandoned the love you had at first.

verses.kjv: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
verses.decoded: Remember how far you have fallen. Turn back and do the things you did at first, or I will come to you quickly and remove your lampstand from its place unless you repent.

verses.kjv: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.decoded: But you do have this: you hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
verses.decoded: Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who wins, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.

verses.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
verses.decoded: Write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: This is the one who is the First and the Last, who died and came back to life, saying,

verses.kjv: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
verses.decoded: I know your troubles, your poverty—even though you are rich—and the insults of those who say they are Jews but are really followers of Satan.

verses.kjv: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
verses.decoded: Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. The devil will throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer for ten days. Be faithful even when facing death, and I will give you the crown of life.

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
verses.decoded: Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who wins will not be hurt by the second death.

verses.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;
verses.decoded: Write to the angel of the church in Pergamos: This is the one who has the sharp two-edged sword, saying,

verses.kjv: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
verses.decoded: I know where you live—where Satan has his throne. Yet you remain faithful to my name and have not denied your faith, even when Antipas, my faithful witness, was killed there where Satan lives.

verses.kjv: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
verses.decoded: But I have a few things against you because you tolerate those who follow the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to cause the Israelites to sin by eating food sacrificed to idols and by committing sexual sin.

verses.kjv: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
verses.decoded: You also tolerate those who follow the teaching of the Nicolaitans, which I hate.

verses.kjv: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.decoded: Turn back from your sins, or I will come to you quickly and fight against them with the sword from my mouth.

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
verses.decoded: Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who wins, I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give a white stone with a new name written on it —one that no one knows except the one who receives it.

verses.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
verses.decoded: Write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: This is the Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze, saying,

verses.kjv: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
verses.decoded: I know your actions, your love, your service, your faith, your patience, and that your last works are better than your first.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
verses.decoded: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. She teaches and leads my servants to commit sexual sin and to eat food sacrificed to idols.

verses.kjv: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
verses.decoded: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to turn away from her sin.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
verses.decoded: So I will throw her on a bed of suffering, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer greatly unless they repent of their actions.

verses.kjv: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
verses.decoded: I will kill her children with death. Then all the churches will know that I am the one who searches hearts and minds, and I will reward each of you according to what you have done.

verses.kjv: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
verses.decoded: Now, to the rest of you in Thyatira who do not hold to her teaching or know the depths of Satan as they claim, I say this: I will not put any other burden on you.

verses.kjv: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
verses.decoded: Hold on to what you have until I come.

verses.kjv: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
verses.decoded: To the one who wins and keeps my works until the end, I will give authority over the nations.

verses.kjv: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
verses.decoded: They will rule them with an iron rod and smash them like clay pots, just as I was given authority by my Father.

verses.kjv: And I will give him the morning star.
verses.decoded: I will also give that person the morning star.

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.decoded: Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

verses.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
verses.decoded: Write to the angel of the church in Sardis: This is the one who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars speaking. I know your actions; you have a reputation for being alive, but you are dead.

verses.kjv: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
verses.decoded: Be alert and strengthen what remains, which is about to die. I have not found your actions complete before God.

verses.kjv: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
verses.decoded: Remember how you received and heard the message, hold on to it, and turn away from your sins. If you do not stay alert, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what time I will come to you.

verses.kjv: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
verses.decoded: You have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their clothes. They will walk with me dressed in white because they are worthy.

verses.kjv: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verses.decoded: The one who overcomes will be dressed in white clothes. I will never erase their name from the book of life, and I will acknowledge their name before my Father and his angels.

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.decoded: Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

verses.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
verses.decoded: Write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: This is the one who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. He opens doors that no one can close and closes doors that no one can open.

verses.kjv: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
verses.decoded: I know your actions. I have placed before you an open door that no one can close. You have little strength, but you have obeyed my word and have not denied my name.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
verses.decoded: I will make those from the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are not and are lying, come and bow down at your feet. They will know that I love you.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
verses.decoded: Because you have kept my message about patient endurance, I will protect you from the time of testing that will come on the whole world to test those who live on the earth.

verses.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
verses.decoded: I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.

verses.kjv: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
verses.decoded: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of my God. They will never leave it again. I will write on them the name of my God, the name of the city of my God—the new Jerusalem coming down from heaven—and my new name.

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.decoded: Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

verses.kjv: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
verses.decoded: Write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: This is the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God's creation, speaking.

verses.kjv: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
verses.decoded: I know your actions. You are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were one or the other!

verses.kjv: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
verses.decoded: But because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I will spit you out of my mouth.

verses.kjv: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
verses.decoded: You say, 'I am rich; I have everything I want and need.' But you do not realize that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked.

verses.kjv: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
verses.decoded: I advise you to buy from me gold refined by fire so you can be truly rich; white clothes to wear so your shameful nakedness is hidden; and eye ointment to put on your eyes so you can see.

verses.kjv: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
verses.decoded: I correct and discipline everyone I love. Be eager, then, and turn away from your sins.

verses.kjv: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
verses.decoded: Look, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me.

verses.kjv: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
verses.decoded: To the one who overcomes, I will let them sit with me on my throne, just as I overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.decoded: Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

verses.kjv: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
verses.decoded: After this, I saw a door open in heaven, and the first voice I heard sounded like a trumpet speaking to me, saying, 'Come up here, and I will show you what must happen next.'

verses.kjv: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
verses.decoded: Right away, I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne set in heaven, with someone sitting on it.

verses.kjv: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
verses.decoded: The one sitting looked like jasper and carnelian stones, and a rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.

verses.kjv: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
verses.decoded: Around the throne were twenty-four seats, and on them sat twenty-four elders dressed in white clothes, wearing gold crowns on their heads.

verses.kjv: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
verses.decoded: From the throne came flashes of lightning, sounds of thunder, and voices. Before the throne were seven lamps burning, which are the seven Spirits of God.

verses.kjv: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
verses.decoded: In front of the throne was a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the center and around the throne were four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind.

verses.kjv: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
verses.decoded: The first creature looked like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth looked like a flying eagle.

verses.kjv: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
verses.decoded: Each of the four creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around. They never stop day or night, saying, 'Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, who was, who is, and who is coming.'

verses.kjv: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,
verses.decoded: Whenever the creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the one on the throne who lives forever and ever,

verses.kjv: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.decoded: the twenty-four elders fall down before the one on the throne, worship the one who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

verses.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
verses.decoded: You are worthy, Lord, to receive glory, honor, and power, because you created all things, and they exist because you wanted them to be.

verses.kjv: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
verses.decoded: I saw a scroll in the right hand of the one sitting on the throne. It was written on the inside and the back, and sealed with seven seals.

verses.kjv: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
verses.decoded: I saw a strong angel shouting loudly, 'Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?'

verses.kjv: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.decoded: No one in heaven, on earth, or under the earth was able to open the scroll or even look inside it.

verses.kjv: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.decoded: I cried a lot because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.

verses.kjv: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
verses.decoded: One of the elders said to me, 'Don't cry. Look, the Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has won the right to open the scroll and break its seven seals.'

verses.kjv: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
verses.decoded: I saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne, the four living creatures, and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had been killed, but it had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.

verses.kjv: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
verses.decoded: The Lamb went and took the scroll from the right hand of the one sitting on the throne.

verses.kjv: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
verses.decoded: When the Lamb took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each had a harp and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God's people.

verses.kjv: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
verses.decoded: They sang a new song: 'You are worthy to take the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed, and by your blood you bought people for God from every tribe, language, people, and nation.'

verses.kjv: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
verses.decoded: You made them a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will rule on the earth.

verses.kjv: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
verses.decoded: I looked and heard the voices of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. Their number was countless—thousands upon thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand.

verses.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
verses.decoded: They shouted with a loud voice, 'The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise!'

verses.kjv: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: Then I heard every creature in heaven, on earth, under the earth, and in the sea, saying, 'Praise, honor, glory, and power belong to the one sitting on the throne and to the Lamb forever and ever!'

verses.kjv: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: The four living creatures said, 'Amen!' The elders fell down and worshiped the one who lives forever and ever.

verses.kjv: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
verses.decoded: I saw the Lamb open one of the seals, and I heard something like thunder. One of the four living creatures said, 'Come and see.'

verses.kjv: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
verses.decoded: I saw a white horse, and the rider had a bow. He was given a crown, and he went out to conquer and keep conquering.

verses.kjv: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
verses.decoded: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, 'Come and see.'

verses.kjv: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
verses.decoded: Another horse came out, red in color. The rider was given power to take peace from the earth so that people would kill each other. He was given a large sword.

verses.kjv: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
verses.decoded: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, 'Come and see.' I saw a black horse, and its rider held a pair of scales in his hand.

verses.kjv: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
verses.decoded: I heard a voice among the four living creatures say, 'A measure of wheat costs a penny, and three measures of barley cost a penny. But don’t harm the oil and the wine.'

verses.kjv: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
verses.decoded: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, 'Come and see.'

verses.kjv: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
verses.decoded: I looked and saw a pale horse. Its rider was named Death, and Hell followed him. They were given power over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword, hunger, death, and wild animals.

verses.kjv: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
verses.decoded: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been killed because of God’s word and their testimony.

verses.kjv: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
verses.decoded: They shouted loudly, 'How long, Lord, holy and true, will you wait before judging and taking revenge on those living on the earth?'

verses.kjv: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
verses.decoded: Each of them was given a white robe. They were told to rest a little longer until the number of their fellow servants and brothers who would be killed like them was completed.

verses.kjv: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
verses.decoded: When the Lamb opened the sixth seal, there was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like a sackcloth made of hair, and the moon became as red as blood.

verses.kjv: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
verses.decoded: The stars in the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when shaken by a strong wind.

verses.kjv: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
verses.decoded: The sky disappeared like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.

verses.kjv: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
verses.decoded: The kings of the earth, the important people, the rich, the commanders, the powerful, and every slave and free person hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.

verses.kjv: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
verses.decoded: They said to the mountains and rocks, 'Fall on us and hide us from the one sitting on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.'

verses.kjv: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
verses.decoded: Because the great day of their anger has come, and who will be able to stand?

verses.kjv: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
verses.decoded: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds so that no wind would blow on the earth, sea, or any tree.

verses.kjv: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
verses.decoded: Then I saw another angel coming up from the east, holding the seal of the living God. He shouted loudly to the four angels who were given power to harm the earth and the sea,

verses.kjv: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.
verses.decoded: saying, 'Do not harm the earth, the sea, or the trees until we have put the seal on the foreheads of God's servants.'

verses.kjv: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: I heard the number of those who were sealed, and it was 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Judah, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Reuben, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Gad, 12,000 were sealed.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Asher, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Naphtali, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Manasseh, 12,000 were sealed.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Simeon, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Levi, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Issachar, 12,000 were sealed.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Zebulun, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Joseph, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Benjamin, 12,000 were sealed.

verses.kjv: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
verses.decoded: After this, I saw a huge crowd that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people, and language. They stood in front of the throne and the Lamb, wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.

verses.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
verses.decoded: They shouted loudly, 'Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!'

verses.kjv: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
verses.decoded: All the angels stood around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures. They fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,

verses.kjv: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: saying, 'Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever. Amen!'

verses.kjv: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
verses.decoded: One of the elders asked me, 'Who are these people dressed in white robes? Where did they come from?'

verses.kjv: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
verses.decoded: I answered, 'You know, sir.' He said to me, 'These are the people who have come out of the great suffering. They have washed their robes and made them white by the blood of the Lamb.'

verses.kjv: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.
verses.decoded: That is why they stand in front of God's throne and serve him day and night in his temple. The one who sits on the throne will live among them.

verses.kjv: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
verses.decoded: They will never be hungry or thirsty again. The sun will not shine on them, and no heat will bother them.

verses.kjv: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
verses.decoded: The Lamb who is at the center of the throne will take care of them and lead them to springs of living water. God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

verses.kjv: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
verses.decoded: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

verses.kjv: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.
verses.decoded: I saw seven angels standing before God, and they were given seven trumpets.

verses.kjv: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
verses.decoded: Another angel came and stood at the altar with a golden censer. He was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of all the holy people on the golden altar in front of the throne.

verses.kjv: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.
verses.decoded: The smoke from the incense, along with the prayers of the holy people, went up before God from the angel's hand.

verses.kjv: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
verses.decoded: The angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it to the earth. Then there were voices, thunder, lightning, and an earthquake.

verses.kjv: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
verses.decoded: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets got ready to blow them.

verses.kjv: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
verses.decoded: The first angel blew his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown to the earth. A third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.

verses.kjv: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
verses.decoded: The second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a big mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood.

verses.kjv: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
verses.decoded: A third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

verses.kjv: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;
verses.decoded: The third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star fell from heaven, burning like a lamp. It fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.

verses.kjv: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
verses.decoded: The star was called Wormwood. A third of the waters became bitter, and many people died from the bitter water.

verses.kjv: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
verses.decoded: The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. A third of them were darkened, so a third of the day had no light, and the same for the night.

verses.kjv: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
verses.decoded: I saw and heard an angel flying through the middle of heaven. He shouted loudly, 'Woe, woe, woe to the people on earth because of the other trumpet sounds from the three angels who are still going to blow!'

verses.kjv: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
verses.decoded: The fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star fall from heaven to the earth. He was given the key to the bottomless pit.

verses.kjv: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
verses.decoded: He opened the bottomless pit, and smoke rose from it like smoke from a huge furnace. The sun and the air were darkened by the smoke from the pit.

verses.kjv: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
verses.decoded: Out of the smoke came locusts onto the earth. They were given power like the power scorpions have on earth.

verses.kjv: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.
verses.decoded: They were told not to harm the grass, any green plants, or any trees, but only those people who do not have God's seal on their foreheads.

verses.kjv: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
verses.decoded: They were allowed to torment those people for five months, but not to kill them. Their pain was like the sting of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

verses.kjv: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
verses.decoded: During those days, people will want to die but will not be able to. They will long to die, but death will avoid them.

verses.kjv: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
verses.decoded: The locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces looked like human faces.

verses.kjv: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
verses.decoded: They had hair like women's hair, and their teeth were like lions' teeth.

verses.kjv: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
verses.decoded: They wore armor like iron breastplates, and the noise of their wings sounded like the noise of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.

verses.kjv: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
verses.decoded: They had tails like scorpions, with stingers in their tails. Their power was to hurt people for five months.

verses.kjv: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
verses.decoded: They had a king over them, the angel of the bottomless pit. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek, he is called Apollyon.

verses.kjv: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
verses.decoded: The first disaster is over, but two more disasters will come.

verses.kjv: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
verses.decoded: The sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the four horns of the golden altar before God.

verses.kjv: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
verses.decoded: The voice said to the sixth angel with the trumpet, 'Release the four angels who are tied up at the great river Euphrates.'

verses.kjv: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
verses.decoded: The four angels were released. They had been kept ready for this moment, for an hour, a day, a month, and a year, to kill one-third of the people on earth.

verses.kjv: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
verses.decoded: The number of the mounted troops was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

verses.kjv: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
verses.decoded: I saw the horses and their riders in my vision. They wore armor made of fire, blue sapphire, and sulfur. The horses’ heads looked like lions’ heads, and fire, smoke, and sulfur came out of their mouths.

verses.kjv: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
verses.decoded: By these three things—fire, smoke, and sulfur—one-third of the people were killed.

verses.kjv: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
verses.decoded: Their power was in their mouths and in their tails. Their tails looked like snakes with heads, and they used them to harm people.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
verses.decoded: But the rest of the people who were not killed by these plagues did not stop doing what they had been doing. They did not stop worshiping demons or idols made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, or wood—idols that cannot see, hear, or walk.

verses.kjv: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
verses.decoded: They also did not stop murdering, practicing magic, committing sexual sins, or stealing.

verses.kjv: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
verses.decoded: I saw another powerful angel coming down from heaven. He was covered with a cloud, had a rainbow over his head, his face shone like the sun, and his feet looked like pillars of fire.

verses.kjv: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
verses.decoded: He held a small open book in his hand. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.

verses.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
verses.decoded: He shouted loudly, like a roaring lion. After he shouted, seven thunders spoke their voices.

verses.kjv: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
verses.decoded: When the seven thunders had spoken, I was ready to write, but I heard a voice from heaven telling me, 'Seal up what the seven thunders said and do not write it down.'

verses.kjv: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
verses.decoded: The angel I saw standing on the sea and the land raised his hand toward heaven,

verses.kjv: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
verses.decoded: and swore by the one who lives forever and ever, the creator of heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, the sea and everything in it, that there would be no more delay.

verses.kjv: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
verses.decoded: But when the seventh angel begins to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be completed, just as he told his servants the prophets.

verses.kjv: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
verses.decoded: Then the voice I heard from heaven spoke to me again and said, 'Go and take the small open book from the angel standing on the sea and the land.'

verses.kjv: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.
verses.decoded: I went to the angel and said, 'Give me the small book.' He said, 'Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but it will taste as sweet as honey in your mouth.'

verses.kjv: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
verses.decoded: I took the small book from the angel's hand and ate it. It tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach became bitter.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
verses.decoded: Then he said to me, 'You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.'

verses.kjv: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.
verses.decoded: I was given a measuring rod like a staff, and an angel stood and said, 'Get up and measure the temple of God, the altar, and those who worship there.'

verses.kjv: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
verses.decoded: But leave out the outer courtyard; do not measure it, because it has been given to the Gentiles. They will trample the holy city for forty-two months.

verses.kjv: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
verses.decoded: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for one thousand two hundred and sixty days, wearing sackcloth.

verses.kjv: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.
verses.decoded: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands standing before the God of the earth.

verses.kjv: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
verses.decoded: If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and burns their enemies. Anyone who tries to harm them must be killed in this way.

verses.kjv: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
verses.decoded: They have power to shut the sky so it will not rain during the days of their prophecy. They also have power over the waters to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.

verses.kjv: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
verses.decoded: When they finish their testimony, the beast that comes up from the bottomless pit will fight against them, defeat them, and kill them.

verses.kjv: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
verses.decoded: Their dead bodies will lie in the streets of the great city, which is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

verses.kjv: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
verses.decoded: People from every race, tribe, language, and nation will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days and refuse to bury them.

verses.kjv: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
verses.decoded: Those who live on the earth will celebrate and be happy, and will send gifts to each other, because these two prophets had tormented them.

verses.kjv: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
verses.decoded: But after three and a half days, the Spirit of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

verses.kjv: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
verses.decoded: They heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, 'Come up here.' Then they went up to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies watched them.

verses.kjv: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.decoded: At that same hour there was a great earthquake. One tenth of the city fell, and seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake. The rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

verses.kjv: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.
verses.decoded: The second disaster is over, but the third is coming soon.

verses.kjv: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: The seventh angel blew his trumpet, and loud voices in heaven said, 'The kingdoms of this world have become the kingdoms of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will rule forever.'

verses.kjv: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,
verses.decoded: The twenty-four elders who sat before God on their thrones fell on their faces and worshiped God.

verses.kjv: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.
verses.decoded: They said, 'We thank you, Lord God Almighty, who is, who was, and who is coming, because you have taken your great power and begun to rule.'

verses.kjv: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.
verses.decoded: The nations were angry, and your anger has come. It is time to judge the dead and reward your servants the prophets, your holy people, and all who respect your name, both small and great. It is time to destroy those who destroy the earth.

verses.kjv: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
verses.decoded: Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant was seen in his temple. There were flashes of lightning, voices, thunder, an earthquake, and heavy hail.

verses.kjv: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:
verses.decoded: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman dressed with the sun, the moon under her feet, and a crown of twelve stars on her head.

verses.kjv: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
verses.decoded: She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.

verses.kjv: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.
verses.decoded: Another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven crowns on its heads.

verses.kjv: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
verses.decoded: Its tail swept a third of the stars from the sky and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman ready to eat her child as soon as it was born.

verses.kjv: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.
verses.decoded: She gave birth to a son who will rule all nations with an iron rod. Her child was taken up to God and his throne.

verses.kjv: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
verses.decoded: The woman fled into the wilderness to a place God prepared for her, where she would be cared for 1,260 days.

verses.kjv: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
verses.decoded: There was a war in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.

verses.kjv: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
verses.decoded: But the dragon was defeated and lost his place in heaven.

verses.kjv: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
verses.decoded: The great dragon was thrown out—the ancient serpent called the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

verses.kjv: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.
verses.decoded: I heard a loud voice in heaven say, 'Now salvation, power, and the kingdom of our God have come, and the authority of his Messiah. The accuser of our brothers and sisters has been thrown down, who accused them before God day and night.'

verses.kjv: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
verses.decoded: They defeated him by the blood of the Lamb and by their testimony. They did not love their lives so much that they were afraid to die.

verses.kjv: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.
verses.decoded: So rejoice, you heavens and all who live there! But woe to the earth and sea, because the devil has come down to you with great anger, knowing he has little time left.

verses.kjv: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.
verses.decoded: When the dragon saw he was thrown to the earth, he chased the woman who had given birth to the son.

verses.kjv: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
verses.decoded: The woman was given two large wings like an eagle’s to fly to the wilderness to her place, where she is cared for a time, times, and half a time, away from the serpent’s presence.

verses.kjv: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
verses.decoded: The serpent spewed water like a river to sweep the woman away with the flood.

verses.kjv: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
verses.decoded: But the earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the flood the dragon spewed out.

verses.kjv: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: The dragon was angry with the woman and went to fight against the rest of her children—those who obey God’s commandments and hold to the testimony of Jesus.

verses.kjv: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.
verses.decoded: I stood on the shore of the sea and saw a beast coming up out of the sea. It had seven heads and ten horns, with ten crowns on its horns, and on its heads were names that insult God.

verses.kjv: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
verses.decoded: The beast I saw looked like a leopard, its feet were like a bear’s, and its mouth was like a lion’s. The dragon gave the beast its power, throne, and great authority.

verses.kjv: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.
verses.decoded: One of the beast’s heads looked like it had been fatally wounded, but the wound was healed. The whole world was amazed and followed the beast.

verses.kjv: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?
verses.decoded: They worshiped the dragon who gave power to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast, saying, 'Who is like the beast? Who can fight against it?'

verses.kjv: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.
verses.decoded: The beast was given a mouth to speak proud words and insults against God. It was given authority to act for forty-two months.

verses.kjv: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
verses.decoded: It opened its mouth to insult God, to insult his name, his home in heaven, and those who live there.

verses.kjv: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.
verses.decoded: The beast was allowed to make war against God’s holy people and to defeat them. It was given authority over every tribe, language, and nation.

verses.kjv: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
verses.decoded: Everyone living on earth will worship the beast, except those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life, the Lamb who was killed from the beginning of the world.

verses.kjv: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
verses.decoded: Anyone with ears should listen carefully.

verses.kjv: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
verses.decoded: Those who lead others into captivity will themselves be taken captive. Those who kill with the sword must be killed by the sword. This is the patient endurance and faith of God’s people.

verses.kjv: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
verses.decoded: Then I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb but spoke like a dragon.

verses.kjv: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
verses.decoded: This second beast used all the power of the first beast and made the people on earth worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.

verses.kjv: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,
verses.decoded: It performed great miracles, even making fire come down from heaven to earth in front of people.

verses.kjv: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
verses.decoded: It fooled the people living on earth by the miracles it was allowed to perform in front of the beast. It told them to make an image of the beast that had been wounded by a sword but lived.

verses.kjv: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
verses.decoded: The second beast was allowed to give life to the image of the first beast so that the image could speak and cause anyone who refused to worship the image to be killed.

verses.kjv: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
verses.decoded: It forced everyone, no matter how small or great, rich or poor, free or slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead.

verses.kjv: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
verses.decoded: No one could buy or sell anything unless they had the mark, the name of the beast, or the number of its name.

verses.kjv: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.
verses.decoded: This calls for wisdom. Anyone with understanding should figure out the meaning of the beast’s number, because it is the number of a man. Its number is 666.

verses.kjv: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father's name written in their foreheads.
verses.decoded: I looked, and there was a Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him were 144,000 people who had his Father's name written on their foreheads.

verses.kjv: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:
verses.decoded: I heard a voice from heaven, like the sound of many waters and loud thunder. I also heard the sound of harpers playing their harps.

verses.kjv: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.
verses.decoded: They sang a new song in front of the throne, the four living creatures, and the elders. No one could learn that song except the 144,000 who were bought from the earth.

verses.kjv: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.
verses.decoded: These are the ones who were not defiled by women; they are virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were bought from among people as the firstfruits for God and the Lamb.

verses.kjv: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.
verses.decoded: No lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless before God's throne.

verses.kjv: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
verses.decoded: I saw another angel flying in the middle of the sky, with the eternal gospel to preach to those living on the earth, to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

verses.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
verses.decoded: He shouted loudly, 'Fear God and give him glory, because the time of his judgment has come. Worship the one who made heaven, earth, sea, and springs of water.'

verses.kjv: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
verses.decoded: Then another angel followed, saying, 'Babylon the great city has fallen because she made all nations drink the wine of her immoral passion and anger.'

verses.kjv: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
verses.decoded: The third angel shouted loudly, 'If anyone worships the beast and its image, and receives its mark on their forehead or hand,

verses.kjv: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
verses.decoded: they will drink the wine of God’s anger, poured full strength into the cup of his wrath. They will be tormented with fire and sulfur in front of the holy angels and the Lamb.

verses.kjv: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.
verses.decoded: The smoke from their torment will rise forever. They will have no rest day or night—those who worship the beast and its image and accept the mark of its name.'

verses.kjv: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
verses.decoded: Here is the endurance of the faithful ones—those who keep God's commandments and hold to the faith of Jesus.

verses.kjv: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
verses.decoded: I heard a voice from heaven say to me, 'Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.' The Spirit says, 'Yes, they will rest from their work, because their deeds follow them.'

verses.kjv: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
verses.decoded: I looked, and there was a white cloud. Sitting on the cloud was someone like the Son of Man, wearing a golden crown and holding a sharp sickle in his hand.

verses.kjv: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
verses.decoded: Another angel came out of the temple and shouted to the one on the cloud, 'Use your sickle and reap, because the time to harvest the earth has come; the crops are ready.'

verses.kjv: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
verses.decoded: The one on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

verses.kjv: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
verses.decoded: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, also holding a sharp sickle.

verses.kjv: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
verses.decoded: Then another angel came from the altar, who had power over fire. He shouted loudly to the one with the sharp sickle, 'Use your sickle and gather the clusters from the earth’s vine, because its grapes are fully ripe.'

verses.kjv: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
verses.decoded: The angel swung his sickle over the earth, gathered the grapes from the vine, and threw them into the great winepress of God's wrath.
